official.line: Wepsai thang kan khong Global Furry Television
official.domain-heading: Wepsai thang kan khong GFTV long thay duay globalfurry.tv lu gftv.asia
official.domain-body: An thi yu chak thay sut, yu chut sut thay kon khueang mai thap diao to tham it. Wepsai thi long thay duay sing uen bo maen khong GFTV, thueng wa sue ni cha pakot yu kon nai thi yu ko tam.
official.trusted-link: Lay sue wepsai thang kan khong GFTV thang mot
official.secure-body: Sok ha aikhon mae kasae, lu https:// yu ton thi yu. Baeng pan khomun suan to sapho yu wepsai thang kan phan kan sueam to thi plotphay thaonan.

how.spot.body: Sok ha HelloSmile yu thoeng bat, sai kho lu pay. Bo wa man yu sai, bon nan maen HelloSpot.

how.hello.body: Khao ma thak thay loei. Yu HelloSpot bo mi phai khat wang wa than cha hu chak phai ma kon.

about.title: Global Furry Television
about.body-1: Global Furry Television (GFTV) maen song khao faen dom foe ri thi nyai thi sut nai Asi, mi than yu Singkapo.
about.body-2: Phuak hao nam sane kan toep to khong sao foe ri hai thuk khon dai suen som thang mue ni lae mue na, lae phuak hao sang phuen thi hai phu khon dai hian hu lae khao chai kan.
about.body-3: Chak ban koet su thavip nyai tang tang, thim ngan GFTV pen thim sakon, lak lai vatthanatham lae lai phasa.
